preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 400,000.
The diameter d must be between 1 and 400,000.
The maximum degree k must be between 1 and 400,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to construct the tree, output 'NO'.
If a tree is constructed, output 'YES' followed by n-1 lines describing the edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(edge.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(edge.split()[1]) <= n for edge in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each edge must connect two valid vertices within the range [1, n].
There must be exactly n-1 unique edges in the output.
